spanish: Y toro de pecado harás al día sobre las expiaciones, y pecarás sobre el altar en tu expiar sobre él, y lo ungirás para santificarlo.

findings.issue: Piel sequential perfect 2ms of H2398 is rendered as pecarás (you will sin), which drops the piel stem force and makes the addressee commit sin.

notes: The remaining tokens match conjunction, construct, person, number, articles, and suffixes.
